description: Small simplified reference panel; +/− typical, v variable, omitted not assessed. Not a clinical database.

organisms.name: Staphylococcus aureus
organisms.note_zh: 典型：Gram(+) 球菌、葡萄串排列、Catalase(+)、Coagulase(+)。
organisms.note_en: Typical G+ cocci in clusters; catalase+ and coagulase+.

organisms.name: Staphylococcus epidermidis
organisms.note_zh: 典型：Gram(+) 球菌、Catalase(+)、Coagulase(−)。仍須與其他凝固酶陰性葡萄球菌鑑別。
organisms.note_en: Typical G+ cocci, catalase+, coagulase−; other coagulase-negative species may resemble it.

organisms.name: Streptococcus pyogenes
organisms.note_zh: 典型：Gram(+) 鏈狀球菌、Catalase(−)、PYR(+)、Bile esculin(−)。
organisms.note_en: Typical G+ cocci in chains, catalase−, PYR+, bile esculin−.

organisms.name: Enterococcus faecalis
organisms.note_en: Typical G+ cocci, catalase−, PYR+, bile esculin+.

organisms.name: Escherichia coli
organisms.note_en: Typical G− rod, oxidase−, indole+, lactose fermenter, citrate−.

organisms.name: Klebsiella pneumoniae
organisms.note_zh: 典型：Gram(−) 桿菌、Oxidase(−)、乳糖發酵(+)、不具運動性、Citrate(+)；Urease 依菌株與時程而異。
organisms.note_en: Typical G− rod, oxidase−, lactose+, nonmotile, citrate+; urease timing can vary.

organisms.name: Enterobacter cloacae complex
organisms.note_zh: 常見：Gram(−) 桿菌、Oxidase(−)、Indole(−)、Citrate(+)、Motility(+)；乳糖與尿素酶可能有變異。
organisms.note_en: Commonly G− rod, oxidase−, indole−, citrate+, motile; lactose and urease vary.

organisms.name: Proteus mirabilis
organisms.note_zh: 典型：Gram(−) 桿菌、乳糖不發酵、Urease(+)、運動性(+)；H₂S 通常陽性。
organisms.note_en: Typical G− non-lactose-fermenting rod, urease+, motile; often H₂S+.

organisms.name: Salmonella enterica (non-typhoidal, typical)
organisms.name_zh: 沙門氏菌（典型非傷寒菌株）
organisms.note_zh: 通常：Gram(−) 桿菌、乳糖不發酵、Urease(−)、運動性(+)、H₂S 常呈陽性；例外菌株存在。
organisms.note_en: Common non-typhoidal G− rods, lactose−, urease−, motile and often H₂S+; exceptions occur.

organisms.name: Pseudomonas aeruginosa
organisms.note_zh: 典型：Gram(−) 桿菌、Oxidase(+)、乳糖不發酵；仍需其他試驗與培養特徵確認。
organisms.note_en: Typical G− rod, oxidase+, lactose nonfermenter; confirm with other tests and culture features.
